target: Conditional direction transfer: approximate native intervention response to recipient component using a donor component from same token and group in another context, holding recipient magnitude fixed.
inventory: Keep original M49 group per input. Deduplicate exact(prefix,group) within domain/source split. Require2+distinct prefixes for same token/group within stratum. Cyclic SHA-prefix permutation; no gate/norm/effect eligibility or selection.
magnitude: Donor delta rescaled per recipient position to current component norm; target-zero positions stay zero; donor-zero nonzero-target failures remain explicitly zero predictions, never silently excluded.
future_primary_metric: Native-probability-weighted squared log-probability response error relative to recipient-component native response, normalized by target response energy. Compare zero-response and fixed norm-matched scrambled-direction controls. Report raw energies/noops and local directional error separately.
limits: Recipient magnitude is oracle information, so success would be direction transfer conditional on token/group/norm, not deployable prediction or semantic unit discovery. Candidates have different target directions; do not call larger disruption better. Context/gating mismatch may defeat transfer.
stopping: Inventory first, then fixed local direction/zero-availability audit, then native response test if supported; no expansion of group assignments or filtering after outcomes. Preserve all cohorts/task exclusions.
